idea.name: Inflatable and event rental
idea.one_liner: Rent bounce houses and related event equipment to families and event hosts for per-item, package, and staffed-event fees.
idea.customer: Families, event hosts, and people needing party or wedding equipment.
idea.offer: Bounce houses, slides, obstacle courses, tables, chairs, tents, heaters, and ACs, with delivery, setup, collection, and optional on-site supervision.
idea.revenue_model: Per-event equipment rental, add-on packages, and hourly on-site supervision.

idea.name: Acquire a retiring owner's business
idea.one_liner: Find a retiring small-business owner, take over an established company, and earn revenue by continuing its operations.
idea.customer: A buyer looking to acquire a going concern; the seller is a retiring business owner. The acquired rental business continues serving event hosts.
idea.offer: Take over and operate a business whose owner wants it to continue after retirement.
idea.revenue_model: Earn revenue from operating the acquired business; purchase price and financing terms are not stated.
